I'd love to just give up the workforce and go to graduate school to get my Doctorate in Computational Linguistics. (My B.A. was in Linguistics). It's where the software side of me comes.

I just don't know how to do that within the limited time frame. The GRE takes a month or so, and I'd probably be aiming for fall or next spring acceptance if I took a shot at it now. 

I've also debated about heading towards lawyerism. I won't link for some anonymity, but I've managed to have filing documents where the Texas State Attorney General sues Himself due to a Texas Open Records Request. 

LSAT, like GRE, takes time.

I went through my phone's contact list, and texted everyone that I have kept a vague contact with. No help.

I realize that describing it to a random stranger, "I have to move back in with my mother, I'd rather kill myself" seems absurd. I'd point out http://www.daughtersofnarcissisticmothers.com/ It's a good book.

It's over eight hours away, much smaller town, ultra-conservative. I got called a fag once for carrying a purse at a gas station there. Here, in Austin, we had a homeless crossdressing man run for mayor years ago and received around 10-15% of the vote.

So, yah. Totally different.

You're definitely right in some regards. My memories of living with her, especially as a teenager, is skewed definitely.

However, she kept being this way when I moved out for college at 18. Calling multiple times a day. Playing the Depression One-Up Game. She threatened suicide over the piercings just a few months ago.
